content:
maria: Hey team — I’m Maria (day 2 on Eng). Trying to finish cloud onboarding. Two asks: 1) AWS: need to assume a role in the dedicated-prod account to run model validation in ap-southeast-1 and decrypt with KMS alias/alias/redwood-prod-kms. 2) GCP: need project linked to billing (project: redwood-eval-eu) and BigQuery read access. Who should I ping to get both?

it-support-bot: Thanks Maria! Please fill the onboarding access form: https://intranet.redwood.internal/onboard-access  Reply here with the AWS account ID and GCP project ID after you submit. Ticket created: INF-4821.

cheng: I can help with the AWS side. Can you paste the 12-digit AWS account ID and the exact role name you want to assume? Also confirm if you need kms:Decrypt on the key or just Encrypt/GenerateDataKey. Example assume-role CLI:```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallEvaluator --role-session-name maria-onboard
```
Make sure your local AWS CLI is profile'd to your personal account first.

maria: AWS account is 987654321098 and role name would be RedwoodModelEvaluator. Yes I need kms:Decrypt so I can load model checkpoints for evals. Also yes, please ensure the role can target ap-southeast-1 (we run inference there). For GCP project id it's redwood-eval-eu (numeric id: 812345678901).

tyler: +1 from me, granting manager approval. Please add Maria to the dedicated-team group and billing-approvals. :thumbsup:

cheng: Ok I’ll open the IAM change. Plan: create a role trust policy for your principal, attach AmazonKMSFullAccess-scoped-to-key (we'll tighten to key ARNs), and add region constraints for ap-southeast-1 if needed. ETA: I’ll have the role and temporary creds ready by EOD. I’ll post the assume-role ARN here when done.

it-support-bot: Note — GCP billing link requires a Billing Admin or Billing Account User role. If you want, I can escalate to cloud-sre to do the billing account link because it touches org-level permissions. Guide: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/link?project=redwood-eval-eu

samira: I can do the GCP billing link. Maria — can you confirm the billing contact email (for notifications) and whether the project is under the EU org folder (org/rdw-eu)? Also confirm that you only need BigQuery Data Viewer (roles/bigquery.dataViewer) and not Storage Admin.

maria: Billing contact: maria@redwood.ai. Project is under org/rdw-eu. BigQuery read-only is fine. Thanks all!

cheng: Update — created role arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodModelEvaluator and added kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:987654321098:key/abcd-ef01-2345. I pushed a temp policy allowing assume-role from your SAML principal and added dedicated-team group. Test like:```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/RedwoodModelEvaluator --role-session-name maria-onboard --profile maria-personal
```
Credentials expire in 1 hour. LMK if you hit permission denied on kms:Decrypt.

samira: I linked redwood-eval-eu to billing account redwood-billing-eu and granted roles/billing.user to maria@redwood.ai. Also added roles/bigquery.dataViewer on project redwood-eval-eu. You should be able to query datasets now.

maria: Confirmed — I could assume the AWS role and decrypt a test object, and BigQuery queries work. Super fast turnaround, appreciate the help everyone! :party_parrot:

cheng: Great. I updated INF-4821 with the final notes and closed the subtask for IAM. If anything else pops up ping me or open a new ticket.

tyler: Welcome aboard again Maria — happy to see you unblocked.
